findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Potentially unsafe use of assert for security checks
 * @description Using assert for runtime security checks can be bypassed with optimized bytecode.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/urllib3-assert-security-check
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-703
 */

import python

from Assert a
where a.getTest().toString().regexpMatch(".*(auth|secure|ssl|cert|token|password|secret).*")
select a, "Assert appears to be used for a security-relevant check; asserts can be stripped with -O."
findings.hypothesis: urllib3 may use Python assert statements for security-relevant checks, which can be stripped with -O.

message.text: Assert appears to be used for a security-relevant check; asserts can be stripped with -O.
